installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

# File: Pterodactyl RuneScape: Dragonwilds Egg - egg-runescape--dragonwilds.json
# Author: David
# Date: 2026/09/16
# License: MIT License

## Download and install SteamCMD
cd /tmp
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

# Install game server using SteamCMD
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) validate +exit

# Set up 32 and 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk{32,64}
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## RuneScape: Dragonwilds setup
# Check for successful installation and make the server binary executable.
# Use `find` with a wildcard rather than the literal binary name, because the
# name is generated by Unreal Engine and may change in a future update.
cd /mnt/server/RSDragonwilds/Binaries/Linux
count=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -name '*-Linux-Shipping' -type f | wc -l)
if [[ $count -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo -e "\n\nSteamCMD failed to install the RuneScape: Dragonwilds Dedicated Server!"
    echo -e "\tTry reinstalling the server again.\n"
    exit 1
else
    chmod +x *-Linux-Shipping
fi

# The Sentry crash reporter ships with the server and is executed by it on a
# crash. Make sure it is executable so crashes are reported instead of hanging.
find /mnt/server/RSDragonwilds/Plugins -maxdepth 6 -name 'crashpad_handler' -type f -exec chmod +x {} \;

echo -e "\nRuneScape: Dragonwilds Dedicated Server successfully installed!\n"

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Quickly checks for any server updates on startup, and updates if necessary. (1 Enable | 0 Disable) Leave this enabled: a server running an older build than the client does not show up in the in-game server browser.

variables.name: Validate Server Files
variables.description: Validates all server files via SteamCMD when Automatic Updates is enabled. (1 Enable | 0 Disable) Significantly increases startup time - only enable if you suspect file corruption.

variables.name: Owner ID
variables.description: Your RuneScape: Dragonwilds Player ID, found in game at the bottom of the Settings menu. Mandatory - the server will not start without it. The matching player becomes the server Owner and is the only one who can unban players. The characters # ; " ` and \ are not allowed - they cannot be stored in the config file.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name of your server, regardless of which world it is running. Note that players search the server browser by world name, not by this name. The characters # ; " ` and \ are not allowed - they cannot be stored in the config file.

variables.name: Default World Name
variables.description: Name of the world created on first boot, and the exact (case sensitive) term players type in Worlds > Public to find your server. Only used when no save exists yet - it does not rename an existing world. Pick something unique. The characters # ; " ` and \ are not allowed - they cannot be stored in the config file.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Mandatory. Anyone who enters this password in Pause Menu > Settings > Server Management becomes an Admin and can ban online players, so treat it as a secret. The characters # ; " ` and \ are not allowed - they cannot be stored in the config file.

variables.name: World Password
variables.description: Optional password players must enter to join. Supersedes any password stored in the world itself. Leave empty to let anyone who knows the world name join. The characters # ; " ` and \ are not allowed - they cannot be stored in the config file.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of concurrent players (writes to Game.ini). Jagex caps dedicated servers at 6 players; lower it to match the RAM you have allocated, which needs roughly 2 GB plus 1 GB per player.

variables.name: Branch Name
variables.description: Steam branch to install. Leave empty for the default (public) branch, or enter a branch name if Jagex has given you access to one. To switch branches on an existing server, also enable Automatic Updates and Validate Server Files.

variables.name: Branch Password
variables.description: Password for the selected Steam branch. Only needed for password-protected branches; leave empty for the default branch.

variables.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds App ID
variables.description: Steam App ID used for installation and updates. This is the free dedicated server tool, which is a separate app from the game itself. Should not be changed.
